$comment: What bounds a surrogate's path scope (ADR 0150 section 8, docs/operators/plugins.md). One definition, two enforcers: the env-spec resolver (crates/env-spec/src/scope.rs) refuses an unbounded `paths=` entry when a schema is read, and the surrogate-proxy plugin (crates/surrogate-proxy/src/plugin/wire.rs) refuses it again on the wire before it issues anything. Each runs every case below. Change a case here and both must follow.
